findings.summary: System dark-mode preference is ignored
findings.evidence: The prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshot is pixel-identical to the light screenshot; the page instead exposes a manual toggle.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and drive surface colors from prefers-color-scheme, while retaining the manual override.

findings.summary: Some controls and links do not preserve sufficient contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured link contrast as low as 3.46:1 on the green notice and 4.19:1 for dark-theme tabs, below 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Use preference-aware color tokens and verify text/control colors in light, dark, and forced-color modes.

findings.summary: Navigation and tab state swaps are abrupt
findings.evidence: The structure probe found no view-transition CSS and the page uses ordinary MPA navigation and Bootstrap tab swaps.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-document transitions to tab changes and progressive cross-document transitions to forum navigation.

findings.summary: Very long listing pages provide no scroll-position feedback
findings.evidence: The mobile layout is 28,788px tall, while screenshots show static header/navigation and the DOM contains no scroll-state/container-query feature.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight declarative scroll-progress or back-to-top affordance that respects reduced motion.

findings.summary: Repeated components adapt only at page level
findings.evidence: The live CSS probe found zero @container rules despite cards/navigation being reused in narrow and wide contexts.
findings.suggestedFix: Use container queries for reusable card and navigation layout decisions rather than relying only on viewport styles.

findings.summary: Many controls are too small and one menu loses visible keyboard focus
findings.evidence: The focus probe found 18 of the first 30 focusable controls below 44px in one dimension; the category link reported outline-style:none and no box shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target padding and provide a high-contrast :focus-visible treatment for every interactive control.

findings.summary: The primary search journey is blocked by Cloudflare
findings.evidence: Submitting the visible search for ドラゴンボール redirected to /search/... and produced “Sorry, you have been blocked” rather than results.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust Cloudflare/WAF search rules and add an automated smoke test for ordinary Japanese queries.

findings.summary: Blocked search offers no in-product recovery
findings.evidence: The search result is a generic Cloudflare block whose only recovery is to email the site owner; it does not preserve the query or offer retry/back-to-results.
findings.suggestedFix: Render a site-owned recoverable error state with retained query, retry, and return controls, and log the Ray ID server-side.

findings.summary: Load responsiveness misses the good performance range
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 3.3s, TBT 320ms, Speed Index 13.6s, and time-to-interactive 33.6s; the trace also measured FCP/LCP 4.50s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise main content, lazy-load below-fold thumbnails, and defer ad/analytics work until after critical rendering.

findings.summary: Third-party work blocks interactivity
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 320ms TBT and 33.6s time-to-interactive, despite the shorter native trace observing only 2.08ms TBT in its window.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer and conditionally load auction/analytics scripts; schedule non-critical work at background priority.

findings.summary: The listing performs hundreds of wasteful requests
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 663 requests and 4.19MB transferred, including 557 image requests and 545 HTTP 403 responses; parser-inserted jQuery/Bootstrap and four stylesheets are candidate blockers.
findings.suggestedFix: Stop requesting inaccessible thumbnails, lazy-load below-fold media, and defer non-critical scripts after confirming dependencies.

findings.summary: Large unused third-party bundles dominate the page
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 529KiB unused JavaScript and 22KiB unused CSS, including 93% of Bootstrap CSS and substantial ad/analytics code.
findings.suggestedFix: Ship a page-specific CSS subset and conditionally load only the advertising/analytics modules needed for visible slots.

findings.summary: Images and form controls lack accessible names
findings.evidence: The image audit found 100/100 images without alt; Lighthouse also failed image-alt and found an unlabeled upload input, while DOM probes found unlabeled search controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Add meaningful alt text or alt="" for decoration, and explicit labels/accessible names for every form control.

findings.summary: Link and tab colors fail WCAG contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 3.46:1 for notice links and 4.19:1 for dark-theme tab links, below the 4.5:1 text minimum.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken link tokens on tinted/light surfaces and lighten them on dark surfaces to reach WCAG AA.

findings.summary: The homepage lacks a heading/main structure and one menu has no focus indicator
findings.evidence: The homepage probe found no headings and no <main>; the category control computed outline:none and box-shadow:none when focused.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a single descriptive h1, wrap primary content in main, and style :focus-visible consistently.

findings.summary: Mobile tab labels wrap one character per line
findings.evidence: The 360px screenshot shows 更新順 and シャッフル split vertically into individual characters, making navigation slow to scan.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow the tab row to scroll or wrap as whole labels; preserve readable line boxes and minimum tab width.

findings.summary: Small touch targets undermine reflow usability
findings.evidence: The focus/geometry probe found 18 of 30 sampled controls below 44px in one dimension, including 17px-high utility links.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase interactive target boxes to about 44x44 CSS px without enlarging text unnecessarily.

findings.summary: Advertising code emits repeated console errors
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed errors-in-console with repeated CORS failures from Geniee and GMO advertising endpoints.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove or correct failing integrations and guard optional ad calls so normal loads stay error-free.

findings.summary: Image assets are broken and unsized
findings.evidence: The image audit found 100 images without dimensions; screenshots show the logo broken, and the HAR contains 545 HTTP 403 responses, mostly thumbnails.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve accessible image URLs, add intrinsic width/height, and use responsive lazy-loaded sources.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs and BFCache blockers remain
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported four deprecation warnings, inspector cookie issues, and five BFCache failure reasons including cache-control:no-store.
findings.suggestedFix: Update/remove deprecated third-party integrations and scope no-store only to responses that truly require it.

findings.summary: Some navigation is not crawlable and all page links are marked nofollow
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found an <a onclick="location.reload()"> without href, and the page declares meta robots index,nofollow despite a public forum; viewport metadata is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Use buttons for actions, real href values for navigation, and remove blanket nofollow where discovery of thread links is intended.

findings.summary: Homepage indexing signals are inconsistent
findings.evidence: The homepage has no canonical URL, declares index,nofollow, and /sitemap.xml returned a Cloudflare block, although robots.txt allows general search crawling.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a self-canonical, expose a valid sitemap, and align robots/meta directives with the intended public indexing policy.

findings.summary: Forum threads lack structured discussion metadata
findings.evidence: Open Graph metadata exists, but the homepage probe found no JSON-LD and the thread exposes no DiscussionForumPosting schema.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate DiscussionForumPosting/BreadcrumbList JSON-LD matching visible thread content.

findings.summary: Session and analytics cookies are insecure and core security headers are absent
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but PHPSESSID lacks Secure and HttpOnly; seven other cookies lack Secure. CSP and nosniff are missing, and HSTS is effectively disabled with max-age=0.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure, HttpOnly, and appropriate SameSite on the session cookie; deploy CSP, nosniff, and a positive HSTS max-age after validation.

findings.summary: The page contacts an excessive tracking ecosystem
findings.evidence: The tracker probe found 41 third-party origins and 12 known tracker domains; the HAR measured 99 third-party requests and 1.19MB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit and remove low-value trackers, require consent where applicable, and batch/minimise analytics.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are mostly absent
findings.evidence: The header probe found no CSP/frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, no Referrer-Policy, no Permissions-Policy, and HSTS max-age=0.
findings.suggestedFix: Add frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, nosniff, and a tested positive HSTS policy.

findings.summary: Network/security failures replace the site with an unrecoverable generic page
findings.evidence: Category, settings, contact, sitemap, and an ordinary search were intermittently replaced by Cloudflare “Sorry, you have been blocked” pages.
findings.suggestedFix: Tune WAF rules and serve site-owned 4xx/failure templates with retry, return, and support context.

findings.summary: Form controls omit useful input metadata
findings.evidence: The DOM probe found empty autocomplete values and no labels on search and upload controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Add explicit labels, input purpose/type, and appropriate autocomplete tokens or autocomplete="off" where values are intentionally not reusable.

findings.summary: Hundreds of thumbnails are fetched eagerly without intrinsic sizing
findings.evidence: The image audit found 99 below-fold images without lazy loading and all 100 sampled images without dimensions; the HAR recorded 557 image requests and 2.96MB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold thumbnails, include dimensions/srcset, and stop requests for inaccessible image variants.

findings.summary: Failed advertising and thumbnail work consumes resources without user value
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 663 requests with 545 HTTP 403 responses, while Lighthouse reported repeated advertising CORS failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Eliminate known-failing requests and defer/condition advertising auctions to visible, consented slots.

findings.summary: Third-party cost is disproportionate to a text forum
findings.evidence: The HAR attributes 1.19MB and 99 requests to third parties; tracker evidence lists 41 third-party origins and 12 known trackers.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a strict third-party budget and remove, consolidate, or defer auction and tracking vendors.
